metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Bryan's cross, the comedy again, and the precept against blue starch.

yesterday: You and Bryan chose the shorter reading and marked it with a cross. He left before a second improvement.
You played the comedy again this afternoon.
The precept is in the house. No blue starch in ruffs. It is to be read on Sunday next.
Alse's one blue band, from Whitsun last, may be washed white.
At table the loaf was a finger and a half short. Under Prices you put it at two fingers.
